items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I must have recorded well over 300 to 400 sides with different groups, which, if I can remember, included Slim and Slam, Art Tatum, Dizzy Gillespie, Benny Goodman, Charlie Parker, Johnny Guarnieri, Hot Lips Page

ctx.x: And speaking of recordings, I can't put my finger on it, but I must have recorded well over 300 to 400 sides with different groups, which, if I can remember, included Slim and Slam, Art Tatum, Dizzy Gillespie, Benny Goodman, Charlie Parker, Johnny Guarnieri, Hot Lips Page and so many more, I can't remember. But I recorded --
